title: The Governance of Human-LLM Interaction: Safety Gating, Civility Steering, and Affective Default Lock-In
reasoning: The paper develops a governance framework and an empirical evaluation pipeline to study the ethical and normative implications of LLM interaction styles. It specifically benchmarks dimensions like harmfulness and inappropriate communication while analyzing the 'normative concerns' regarding human autonomy, value alignment, and the 'moral status' of AI agents.
